title: Welcome to the Towers

slides.title: Welcome to Netville
slides.text: Welcome to Netville, a town that runs on numbers. Its lanterns, bridges and clocks all work because numbers do their jobs. Down below lies the Numberworks, a street of busy workshops. Above it rise seven towers, and over them all hangs the Great Clock.

slides.title: The clock has stopped
slides.text: Tally the cat keeps the keys to every tower, and Tally will be your guide. Last night the Jumble, a troublemaker who mixes things up, knocked the Great Clock's seven gears out of line. Now the hands stand still, and nobody in Netville agrees on the time.

slides.title: Numbers that move together
slides.text: In the towers, two amounts often change together. A mix of 2 cups of oats for every 3 cups of milk stays the same mix when both amounts are scaled.
steps: 2 cups of oats go with 3 cups of milk
8 go with how many? Scale again

visual.label: Oats and milk in one mix

focus.cue: Each pair is one mix: 2 cups of oats go with 3 cups of milk.
Double both amounts and the mix is the same: 4 and 6.
8 cups of oats is 4 times as much. How much milk?

slides.title: Numbers below zero
slides.text: Some numbers up here sit below zero. The Cold Store keeps a sample at −5°C. Warm it by 8° and it climbs past zero to 3°C. A number line that stands upright shows the whole trip.

visual.label: A sample warming from below zero

focus.cue: The sample starts at −5°C and warms by 8°: up the line.
It passes zero and stops at 3°C.

slides.title: Your quest
slides.text: Your quest is to climb all seven towers and win back each tower's gear. A tower has three steps: a short lesson, three questions and a mission game. Nothing is timed, and a wrong try earns a hint. Bring every gear home and the Great Clock will tick again.

slides.title: Words to know
slides.text: Four words you will use in every tower.

words.means: a comparison of two amounts, such as 2 cups of oats for every 3 cups of milk
to multiply every part by the same number, so the mix stays the same
a number less than zero, such as −5
a letter, such as x, that stands for a number you have not found yet

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: There is no game in this step. Answer the three questions, then find the Mixing Tower on the course map. It holds the first gear, the Ratio Gear, and the Great Clock will not start until all seven gears are back.

talk: Where have you seen a number below zero, or two amounts that had to stay in the same ratio?
